boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 124 is a Hard polyomino maze where a green snake path and a purple winding shape form one-way lanes through the grid. The red `32` star block and cyan pocket are the main objectives, but the snake and winding shapes dictate the extraction order — slide them out of sequence and the grid seals, trapping the numbered star blocks with no lane back.
landmarks: Block Out Level 124 is a Hard polyomino maze where a green snake path and a purple winding shape form one-way lanes through the grid.

The red `32` star block and cyan pocket are the main objectives, but the snake and winding shapes dictate the extraction order — slide them out of sequence and the grid seals, trapping the numbered star blocks with no lane back.
The board mixes Red, Blue, Cyan and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Drain the cyan `1`/`3`/`8` pocket in ascending order before moving the yellow `1` tile.
Spend the green `9` counter before breaking the red `32` star block.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the upper-left blue blocks and unwind the green snake path without touching the red `32` star tile.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the top `10`/`10` corner labels and the left-edge green `20` counter to open the maze center.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the red `32` star block once the orange L-shapes along the center-right have room to shift.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Spend the cyan `1`/`3`/`8` pocket tiles in order — `1` first, then `3`, then `8` — before the yellow `1` tile moves.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Detonate the mid-grid blue `15`, green `9`, and cyan `5` counters while the purple winding shape is still movable.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the remaining orange L-scraps and the bottom white `3` stack for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Pulling the cyan `8` tile before the `1` — this boxes the yellow `1` tile against the purple snake.
Breaking the red `32` star before the green `9` counter clears, trapping the orange L-shape on the right wall.
